public_transform: Field allowlist; only synthetic trial tool inputs and final answers; home/workspace paths and session identifiers replaced. No historical transcript, raw system/developer text, token, certificate or tool output exported.
base_hash_note: Legacy base hashes use SHA256(json.dumps(base_instructions, sort_keys=True).encode()); new runner canonical hashes use compact UTF8 JSON, so hash schemes differ.
conditions: Shared replaces only base instructions. Skills/global instructions/tool metadata remain a confound.
judging: Regex candidate labels audited by the same investigating assistant; not independent human annotation and not blinded.
dates_note: Registration timestamps are local metadata, not independently timestamped preregistrations.
